A goat has a boat by the road. His goal is a ride to the coast. He gives his boat a coat of soap. The boat goes off the road! The boat can float, but the goat left his toast. There goes the goat in his fast boat! Una cabra tiene un bote junto al camino. Su meta es un viaje a la costa. Le da a su bote una capa de jabón. ¡El bote se sale del camino!
